sources.notes: Feed found by autodiscovery on 4 October 2026 and read successfully once. County-wide feed (The Events Calendar; 30 upcoming items on 4 October); only items whose location names Niwot are taken.

sources.name: Niwot Business Association (niwot.com)
sources.notes: The Niwot Business Association's site, added as a source on the owner's word, 20 October 2026. Its calendar (Modern Events Calendar) publishes /events/feed/: one item per event at its next date, with mec:startDate, mec:startHour, mec:endDate, mec:endHour, mec:location and mec:category; the plugin's site-wide iCal feed is switched off. The feed holds ten items, the next ten events in date order, which on 20 October reached July 2027. Filed as chamber, not venue: the board also carries other groups' events, so nothing from it is approved without a person, and another group's event is confirmed on that group's own page. Excluded: the Tree Carving Fundraiser, a donation appeal the calendar repeats every Tuesday with no time or place; Trivia Night, The Wheel House's weekly regular, which the guide lists from the venue; and the Hormone Health Small Group Medical Program, an enrollment clinic program at a day spa, which is a promotion, not an event.

sources.name: Boulder Public Library District - Gunbarrel Library events
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Not a Niwot venue: Niwot has no library of its own, and no item in the district's feed names Niwot. This is the district branch nearest Niwot, in Gunbarrel (a search result for the calendar's event pages gives 6500 Lookout Rd.; the address was not on the event page read); whether Niwot addresses are inside the Boulder Public Library District was not checked, and whether a Gunbarrel branch belongs on the Niwot guide is the owner's call. The calendar at calendar.boulderlibrary.org is Communico; its feeds are served from boulderlibrary.libnet.info/feeds?data=<base64 JSON of {feedType, filters}> (the same shape Castle Rock's dcl-org uses; the calendar.boulderlibrary.org host answers 404 for /feeds). The all-branches iCal read 200 text/calendar with 500 VEVENT (capped), reaching only to 16 December, 403 of them in the next 30 days across Main, NoBo, Meadows, Reynolds, Gunbarrel and Virtual. The feedUrl here is the same feed limited to location 4559, Gunbarrel Library (the id comes from the calendar's own event data): 161 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, through December 2027, every LOCATION beginning 'Gunbarrel Library - ' with a room or nothing. 35 items in 10 November to 9 December, parsed with the ingest's own iCal reader: about 20 are storytimes (Baby Time, Toddler Storytime, Preschool Storytime, Storytime, Storytime at Gunbarrel), the rest one-offs and monthly groups such as Active Minds: Native Americans of Colorado (16 Nov), Gunbarrel Classic Movies (22 Nov), Shelf Talkers Book Club, Short Story Book Club, Social Stitchers, Tinker Art Studio (30 Nov), Bad Art Night (3 Dec), Winter Baby Rave (5 Dec), Community Chats (7 Dec). Items carry no URL; an event's page is calendar.boulderlibrary.org/event/<UID>. robots.txt on both hosts disallows only /results* and site search, so /feeds is allowed. If confirmed, the storytimes want an excludeTitles list ('Storytime', 'Baby Time') or the guide gets five a week, and defaultVenue 'Gunbarrel Library'. The Longmont Public Library was not added: it is in Longmont and has no Niwot branch. Gunbarrel counts for Niwot from 10 November 2026: asked whether Gunbarrel venues belong on the Niwot guide, the owner said yes. Confirmed the same day, for the Gunbarrel branch only (the location filter). The weekly storytimes and baby times (about 70 of 87 items in 120 days), the book clubs, the stitching, writing and game groups and the computer class are excluded by title, as on the other library feeds; what is left is the concert, the classic movies, the Active Minds talks and the one-off programs.

sources.name: Niwot Hall (Left Hand Grange)
sources.notes: The hall's rental calendar (Modern Events Calendar), read 20 October 2026 at /events/feed/: ten items, the coming week only (the plugin ignores paging and its iCal export is off), mixing public events with band practice, rehearsals and private bookings. The hall marks the public ones 'Featured Event', which is the include filter; the Rotary's weekly breakfast is already listed as a regular and the election commission's meetings are civic notices. No location element: the hall is the venue. A one-week window read on Mondays lists that week's talks and seminars; longer notice has to come from the organizers' own pages. Confirmed 20 October 2026 on the owner's delegation; 16 published events already cite the site. "Rebuilding Seminars" excluded 1 November 2026: the hall marks the Sunday 5 to 8 pm sessions a featured event, but they are the ten-week divorce-recovery course, a closed group that enrolls in advance (checked 21 October); the 1 November ingest published one under the rules and it came straight off. The course's public introductory evening is a separate listing.

sources.name: The Wheel House
sources.notes: Added 31 October 2026, when a check for missed Niwot events found the bar's calendar carried a band every Friday and Saturday, a Halloween party and a weekly euchre night, none of them on the guide, which had only its Tuesday trivia (from niwot.com). The calendar is a Squarespace calendar block (collection 67cc8d31ad15874647ad995d) that the page fills by script; the page's own data call, /api/open/GetItemsByMonth?month=MM-YYYY&collectionId=67cc8d31ad15874647ad995d, returns each month's items with start and end, and each item's page answers ?format=json with its description. Ingest has no Squarespace reader, so this is read by hand until one is written. The calendar entries' times are sometimes an hour where the description gives longer (trivia shows 6:30 to 7:30; niwot.com gives 6:30 to 8:30). The Squarespace reader, 10 November 2026: it reads an events page in its list view. This calendar is a calendar block filled by script from /api/open/GetItemsByMonth, which the site's robots.txt disallows, so the reader does not help here unless the bar adds an events page in list view. Not fetched again today. Turned on 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3"). The calendar block's collection has a page of its own, /events, in the list view, which the site's robots.txt allows; typed squarespace with that page as its feedUrl and read under honor, so no subscribe is needed. The address was learned from one call to /api/open/GetItemsByMonth (disallowed by robots.txt), made that day on the owner's go for reading this calendar; ingest does not use it. Read by the reader: 23 items to January, 9 trivia nights and 8 euchre nights, which the guide already lists as weekly and the exclusions keep out, and 6 others: Strange Byrds (13 Nov), Starlight and Pine (14 Nov), Red Sax Jazz Band, Dougs Garage, Buzz Brothers and a Branch & Barrel whiskey tasting. Items carry no location, so the default venue is the bar.

sources.name: Fritz Family Brewers
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Niwot's brewery (the site's title is 'Brewery | Fritz Family Brewers | Niwot, Colorado'; street address not read) has a /calendar page (200). It is a Wix site and the calendar is drawn by script from Wix's Google Calendar and Events apps, so the fetched HTML carries no event text and no events could be counted. No Google calendar id appears in the page source, so the public .ics behind it could not be found without a browser; if the brewery will share its calendar's address, that would be an iCal feed, subject to calendar.google.com's robots.txt, which disallows unlisted agents. robots.txt allows the page. Read by hand in a browser until then. The calendar's address found 10 November 2026, after the owner sent screenshots of it: the Wix page's embed loads calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=info@fritzfamilybrewers.com, whose public iCal address is the feedUrl. Read once that day: calendar name 'Fritz Family Brewers', America/Denver, 346 VEVENTs, nearly all the day's food truck (Pong Thai 56, The Maine Event 35, Cruagh Irish 34 and so on), six CLOSED days and the 'National Lager Day' kind of marker. What is an event: Trivia, the first and third Mondays, 6:30 to 7:30 pm (two monthly recurrences, no end date), and in summer Kölsch Service, Wednesdays 5 to 7 pm (this year's ran 20 May to 30 September). No LOCATION on most items, so the brewery is the default venue. The food trucks, closures and beer-day markers are excluded by title; a new truck's name will slip through until it is added. calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows every agent, so under robots: honor ingest will not read this; it is the calendar the brewery embeds on its own site, and robots: subscribe is the owner's call, as for the school calendars. Expect two listings a month, and a weekly one from May to September. 10 November 2026, the owner's word: the food trucks are listed (a thin guide, and they are most of what the brewery posts), so only the closures and the beer-day markers are excluded; and the feed is read under robots: subscribe, the calendar being the one the brewery embeds on its own page.

sources.name: Left Hand Valley Courier
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. Niwot's weekly paper. Its Events section (/section/events, 200; 'Results 1 - 50 of 244') is news stories about events, newest first, with sub-sections for First Friday Art Walk, Enchanted Evening, Holiday Market, Rock & Rails, Niwot Jazz Festival, Lobsterfest, Honey Bee Harvest Festival, House Blend Band concerts, lectures and others; the top stories on 10 November were the Great Pumpkin Party (31 Oct) and the Historical Society's 21 October Now & Then lecture on the Niwot Cemetery. There is no calendar with dated entries. The site's one feed, https://www.lhvc.com/rss, answered 200 with 30 items, but it is the general news feed with no event dates, so ingest would skip every item; it is not recorded as a feedUrl. robots.txt allows the section for our agent (it blocks named AI crawlers and carries a content signal of search=yes, ai-train=no). For leads and attribution: an event found here is confirmed on the organizer's own page.

sources.name: Niwot Community Association
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026. A once-a-year checklist of half a dozen dates, read by hand.

sources.name: Niwot High School - Niwot Activities & Events calendar
sources.lastNote: feed answers but calendar.google.com robots.txt disallows our agent, and the next 30 days are all student club meetings
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026 so nobody looks twice. The school's home page embeds one public Google calendar, 'Niwot Activities & Events' (svvsd.org_2iseneltdfah8uip6cbfbbafq8@group.calendar.google.com). Its public .ics answered 200 (185 KB, 535 VEVENT, heavily recurring) and parsed with the ingest's own reader: 196 occurrences in 10 November to 9 December, none with a location, and every one a student club meeting (Cyber Patriots, Key Club, Mock Trial, Art Club and so on), a military recruiter visit or a 'Late Start' marker. No concert, play, game or community night is on it in that window. Kept manual for two reasons: calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows unlisted agents (as recorded for Elizabeth's library), and the content is not what the guide lists. The school's concerts, theatre and athletics must be on another calendar; www.svvsd.org answered 429 Too Many Requests to every calendar path tried on 10 November, including /st-vrain-athletic-events-calendar/, so the district's calendars (the existing svvsd-org entry) could not be checked for a feed.

sources.name: MainStage Brewing, Gunbarrel taproom (music and events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Not in Niwot: the Lyons brewery's second taproom and music room is at 6035 Longbow Drive, Unit 9, Boulder 80301 (Gunbarrel, about four miles south of Old Town Niwot; the address is from the events' own location field), in the space that was Beyond the Mountain Brewing, whose own site no longer answers. Whether a Gunbarrel room belongs on the Niwot guide is the owner's call, as for the Gunbarrel library. The /gunbarrel page promises free music every Friday and Sunday, a weekly bluegrass pick, trivia and Magic the Gathering. The site is Squarespace, but the calendar on /music is not a Squarespace collection: it is a SociableKIT widget that mirrors each taproom's Facebook events, and the page loads its data from https://data.accentapi.com/feed/25613355.json (Gunbarrel; 25613350 is Lyons), found by loading the page in a browser. That JSON was read once: 28 events, 8 to 30 November only (about three weeks ahead), each with name, start date and time, location and its facebook.com/events link. From 10 to 30 November, 8 are worth a row: Boulder Dead Night (Thu 12 Nov, 6 pm), MainGrass (Fri 13, 20 and 27 Nov, 6 pm; a different hand-picked bluegrass line-up each week, named in each event's description), MainJazz (Sun 15, 22 and 29 Nov, 5:30 pm) and DJ Night with DJ Gourmet and Asano (Sat 21 Nov, 7 pm); nothing is posted yet for 1 to 10 December, so expect about 11 a month. 18 are regulars, excluded by title: TRIVIA Night (Mondays), All Access Tuesday and Temaki Tuesday, Gunbarrel Run Club (Tuesdays), Open Bluegrass Pick'n (Wednesdays), $5 Dice & Drafts and MAGIC: The Gathering (Thursdays). End times in the feed equal the start times, so no end time is known. robots.txt on www.mainstagebrewing.com is Squarespace's standard one (the page is allowed; /api/ and ?format=json are not, and were not fetched); data.accentapi.com has no robots.txt (404). Typed manual: ingest has no reader for this widget's JSON, and the feed is a third party's copy of Facebook, so it is read by hand from the /music page until the owner decides otherwise. Gunbarrel counts for Niwot from 10 November 2026: asked whether Gunbarrel venues belong on the Niwot guide, the owner said yes. Typed json and confirmed the same day: the widget's events file is read by the new SociableKIT reader (scripts/lib/feeds/sociablekit.ts); data.accentapi.com has no robots.txt, so it is read under honor. The file reaches about three weeks ahead.

Three are regulars and not for the calendar: Trivia with Trevonious Monk (Tuesdays 6:30 to 8:30 pm), Full Throttle Yoga (first, third and fifth Sundays, 10:30 am) and Beer & Board Game Days (Sundays). The Halloween party of 31 October was still listed. Each entry has a Details panel that was not opened. Read by hand; three or four listings a month. Gunbarrel counts for Niwot from 10 November 2026: asked whether Gunbarrel venues belong on the Niwot guide, the owner said yes. Still a page a person reads: no feed. Its comedy nights are also on Eventbrite (Next Stop Comedy at Avery, 25 Nov).

sources.name: Niwot High School Orchestra and Mariachi (upcoming concerts)
sources.defaultVenue: Niwot High School Auditorium, 8989 Niwot Road
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Niwot High School is at 8989 East Niwot Road (the address on the band boosters' site); the school's Performing Arts page (nhs.svvsd.org/activities-arts-athletics/performing-arts/) links this site for orchestra, niwotchoir.weebly.com for choir and niwothstheater.weebly.com for theatre. One hand-written page lists the year's concerts, 17 lines for 2026 to 27, not in date order. Three at the school fall in 10 November to 10 December: NHS Open House Performance (Symphony Orchestra and Mariachi Ensembles, Tue 17 Nov, 5:30 pm, NHS Auditorium), the Orchestra's 'Symphony of the Solstice' concert (Wed 9 Dec, 6 pm, NHS Auditorium) and the Mariachi Winter Concert (Thu 10 Dec, 6 pm, NHS Auditorium). Also listed in the window but not in Niwot: the SVVSD Honor Orchestra and Honor Mariachi, Thu 19 Nov at Erie High School. Later: Chinese New Year Performance 30 Jan 2027 at Silver Creek High, 'The Senses Awaken' 10 Mar, Mariachi Entre Las Flores 11 Mar and 11 May (the page gives both), Music Award Night 30 Apr, 'A Night of Nostalgia' 12 May. No ticket price is given. Squarespace, but a plain text page, not an events collection, so there is no feed; robots.txt is Squarespace's standard one and allows the page. None of these concerts is on the school's Google calendar (the nhs-svvsd-org entry), which holds only club meetings. Read by hand each term; two or three listings a month in concert season.

sources.name: Niwot High School Bands (calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The band boosters' site for Niwot High School, 8989 East Niwot Road (page footer). The calendar page carries a Squarespace calendar block that the page fills by script, as The Wheel House's does; its data call is under /api/, which robots.txt disallows, so the block was not read and the marching and concert bands' dates were not counted. What was read is the jazz bands' printable list the page links, 'Important Dates for NHS Jazz Bands 2026-27' (a Google Doc; docs.google.com's robots.txt allows /document). One date in 10 November to 10 December is a public concert at the school: Winter Jazz in the Rockies, the NHS Jazz Bands in the NHS Commons, Wed 2 Dec, 7 pm. Others in the window are not listings: a jazz combo at the school's open house (10 Nov, select performers), an audition deadline (16 Nov) and the Combined League Honor Jazz Band at 'FHS' (17 Nov, concert 6 pm, not in Niwot). Later: Combo-rama at Bricks on Main, Longmont, 26 Jan 2027. The page says the Google docs were current as of May 2026 and the online calendar is the one kept up to date. The winter band concert is likely on the calendar block; a person reading the page in a browser will see it. Read by hand; one or two listings a month.

sources.name: Niwot High School Theater

sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The school theatre department's own site (Weebly), linked from the school's Performing Arts page. sources.name: Emory Jane's Coffee Co. (coffee truck stops)

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Niwot
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Niwot, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Niwot. Read that day: 99 events in five pages, 1 of them in town: Toys In The Attic (2026-11-14, Niwot High School Auditorium). Eventbrite lists every organizer's events, so this is filed as other and its items wait for a person; classes and workshops are most of what a small town shows. robots.txt at www.eventbrite.com allows the page for ordinary agents (it disallows its internal /api/v3/destination/ search, which the reader does not use). Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection of its pages; confirming this source is the owner's decision with that in mind. The event search API was shut in 2020, and the API that remains lists only the token holder's own events. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("for all towns as well use eventbrite"), told that Eventbrite's terms restrict automated collection and that robots.txt allows the page. Still filed as other: its items wait for a person. autoApprove from 10 November 2026, the owner's word ("auto publish all; having to manually do it would defeat the purpose of the town network setup"): its items publish under the standing rules, and one that may be an event already on the guide at that hour still waits.
